title: Raspberry Pi Imager OS Download Shares 2021-2026
subtitle: OS shares of Raspberry Pi Imager downloads as a time series since 2021
sources: Raspberry Pi Imager statistics page https://rpi-imager-stats.raspberrypi.com/ (published by Raspberry Pi Ltd), monthly window. History 2021-2026 reconstructed from Internet Archive captures of that page, weekly scrape since 2026. Collection and method: https://github.com/raspberry-tips/rpi-os-trends

resources.description: Full time series in long format: one row per date, dimension and label. Percent values are shares of Raspberry Pi Imager downloads in the source's rolling 30-day window.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Date of the observation (YYYY-MM-DD). Each value covers the 30 days up to this date.

fields.name: dimension
fields.description: What is being counted: os (operating system or image family), host_arch (CPU architecture of the computer running the Imager, not the image bitness) or locale (Imager UI language).

fields.name: label
fields.description: Category within the dimension as named by the source, e.g. 'Raspberry Pi OS (64-bit)', 'x86_64' or 'de_DE'.

fields.name: percent
fields.description: Share of Imager downloads in percent for this date, dimension and label.

resources.description: The same time series as history.csv in JSON, one entry per date with all dimensions.
Latest snapshot of the source with every dimension and all three windows (today, week, month). 'top_10' is kept for backwards compatibility.
